title: Lightly at CVPR 2026
body_markdown:
CVPR brings together the best researchers and engineers working on computer vision - from foundational methods to real-world applications. It's one of our favorite places to connect with the community, learn what problems people are solving, and share how Lightly fits into modern CV workflows.


If you're attending, we'd love to meet. Come find us and let's talk about your data pipeline, model training challenges, or anything computer vision.
